zh: 反复把一个数替换成各位数字之和，最后得到的是它的数根。一个数和它的各位数字之和模 9 同余，所以不必真的一遍遍模拟。
正整数的数根可以直接用 1+(x−1) mod 9 算出，0 的数根是 0。算出每个数的数根后统计 0 到 9 的出现次数，再挑次数最多、次数相同时数字更大的那个。
开一个长度为 10 的计数数组；对每个数，若为 0 则计入 0，否则计入 1+(x−1) mod 9；从 0 到 9 依次比较，次数更多或次数相同但数字更大时更新答案；输出答案。
en: Repeatedly replacing a number with the sum of its digits ends at its digital root. A number is congruent to its digit sum modulo 9, so there is no need to simulate the process.

The digital root of a positive integer x is 1 + (x - 1) mod 9, and the digital root of 0 is 0. Count how often each digit 0..9 appears as a root, then pick the most frequent, preferring the larger digit on ties.

Use a count array of size 10. For each number, count 0 if it is 0, otherwise count 1 + (x - 1) mod 9. Go through the digits 0 to 9 and update the answer when a digit has a higher count, or the same count and a larger value. Print the answer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

The digital root of a positive integer is 1+(x−1)%9, and 0 maps to 0 separately. Count the frequencies of the ten results, then compare by count and by digit.

## Correctness

A decimal number is congruent modulo 9 to the sum of its digits, and repeated reduction keeps this congruence; a positive number ends up in 1..9, which is uniquely given by the formula above, and 0 stays 0. Comparing by maximum frequency and then by the larger digit implements the requirement.

## Complexity

Time O(n), extra space O(10).
